Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.subsea

Class FieldNetworkSurfDesignBasis

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.subsea.FieldNetworkSurfDesignBasis
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FieldNetworkSurfDesignBasis extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable SURF design basis derived from one canonical FieldNetworkTopology.

This class is an aggregation view, not a second network. It reads stable typed identities and the geometry of the corresponding LoopedPipeNetwork edges so field-development design and cost calculations use the same wells, manifolds, terminations, flowlines, pipelines and risers as the hydraulic model.

1.0
Author:
